run5Comparison.timingNote: Run5 traces were not timestamped and included eleven resumed model turns.
run5Comparison.functionalFinding: Run6 improved schema-backed authoring and produced an actionable breadcrumb before the grid, but regressed root uniqueness and page-state separation. Run5 had 14 root categories and hid detail until selection; Run6 renders 37 root cards and the detail shell at all times.

hardPointReview.impact: The harness supplied the reduced fresh-agent prompt but not the complete black-box UX contract, omitting the 14-root count and distinct detail route.
hardPointReview.evidence: The actual prompt hash differs from the post-run self-contained prompt; campaign-protocol.md said to provide legacy-ux-spec.md but the launch stdin contained only retailstore-fresh-agent-prompt.md.
hardPointReview.nextAction: Use the corrected self-contained prompt and verify its hash before the next fresh run.

hardPointReview.impact: The root renders 37 cards instead of 14 and repeats EPICERIE SUCREE three times.
hardPointReview.nextAction: Make the canonical root count and uniqueness explicit in progress/acceptance suggestions; require an agent to validate fixed fixture counts.

hardPointReview.impact: The product detail placeholder is visible at root and the complete product grid remains visible above detail.
hardPointReview.evidence: The generated Flow contains unconditional category, product and detail blocks; flow-app-progress still reports 9/9.
hardPointReview.nextAction: Add a simple schema-backed conditional/page-state block and make progress flag mutually exclusive catalog/detail states.

hardPointReview.impact: The agent declared success by selecting the last available card without checking root count, uniqueness or hidden detail state.
hardPointReview.nextAction: Expose exact fixture-derived acceptance assertions in the campaign harness and require them before final reporting.

hardPointReview.impact: Tree, palette and progress calls consumed 775 seconds, about 21 percent of observed active time.
hardPointReview.nextAction: Cache parsed frontend catalogs/AST indexes and return focused deltas instead of repeatedly rebuilding full trees.

hardPointReview.impact: The breadcrumb schema was temporarily interpreted as a product schema.
hardPointReview.evidence: The agent repaired iterator identities after picker diagnostics.
hardPointReview.nextAction: Generate unique palette IDs and reject duplicate scope IDs at mutation time.

hardPointReview.impact: Browser validation was delayed by missing local module resolution and stale MCP preview ports.
hardPointReview.evidence: Four setup/connection command failures before using the local runner and port 19080.
hardPointReview.nextAction: Provide one stable built URL and a preinstalled standalone Playwright runtime to fresh agents.

hardPointReview.impact: The Flow had to use typed json.parse to normalize numeric fixture fields.
hardPointReview.evidence: Agent final report and visible InitializeCatalog Flow.
hardPointReview.nextAction: Consider a small typed number.parse block if the pattern recurs.

hardPointReview.impact: A services/logs.Add fetch is attempted during strict offline navigation, although catalog data remains local.
hardPointReview.nextAction: Queue or suppress SDK remote logging while offline without affecting FullSync reads.
